name: rosetta-combinations-with-repetitions
code:
use default

combos[T](items: List[T], k: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[LIST[T]] is
    if k == 0 then
        yield LIST[T]()
    else
        for i in 0..items.count do
            for rest in combos(items[i..<0], k - 1) do
                let combo = LIST[T]([items[i]])

                for item in rest do
                    combo.add(item)
                od

                yield combo
            od
        od
    fi
si

let doughnuts = ["iced", "jam", "plain"]
let picks = combos(doughnuts, 2)

let choices = doughnuts |> join(", ")

write_line("choosing 2 from {choices}: {picks |> count()} ways")

for pick in picks do
    write_line("  {pick |> join(", ")}")
od

let ten_types = LIST[int](1::10)
let ways = combos(ten_types, 3) |> count()

write_line("choosing 3 from 10 types: {ways} ways")
